findings.text: the paragraph states the lowered program at "8,408,375 bytes at 8 cells in the census fixture, 6,088,067 at 132 in the production row program", but the cited `docs/evidence/fragments/kernel-compile-barrier/bounded-jets-build.html:13` reports those as one program lowered on CPU at four cell counts — "lowering `production_point_batch` on CPU gives 8,408,375 StableHLO bytes at 8 cells, 7,482,936 at 16, 6,461,067 at 64 and 6,088,070 at 132" — and no fragment places 8,408,375 in the census fixture; 6,088,067 is the H200 head receipt (`bounded-jets-build.html:22`, `ordered-sharing.html:15`), three bytes off the 132-cell CPU lowering.
